promotions_schedule_valid.name: promotions_schedule_valid
promotions_schedule_valid.value: "promotions"."ends_at" is null or "promotions"."starts_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"

promotions_active_configured.name: promotions_active_configured
promotions_active_configured.value: not "promotions"."active" or ("promotions"."allocation_strategy" is not null and "promotions"."price_policy" is not null)

payment_proof_private.name: payment_proof_private
payment_proof_private.value: "payments"."proof_object_key" is null or ("payments"."proof_object_key" like 'payment-proof/%' and "payments"."proof_object_key" not like '%..%')

payment_submission_valid.name: payment_submission_valid
payment_submission_valid.value: "payments"."status" = 'pending' or ("payments"."proof_object_key" is not null and "payments"."proof_mime" is not null and "payments"."proof_bytes" is not null and "payments"."proof_bytes" > 0 and "payments"."submitted_at" is not null)

payment_verification_valid.name: payment_verification_valid
payment_verification_valid.value: "payments"."status" <> 'verified' or ("payments"."verified_by" is not null and "payments"."verified_at" is not null)

review_moderation_required.name: review_moderation_required
review_moderation_required.value: "reviews"."status" = 'pending' or ("reviews"."moderated_by" is not null and "reviews"."moderated_at" is not null)

shipment_tracking_required.name: shipment_tracking_required
shipment_tracking_required.value: "shipments"."status" = 'pending' or ("shipments"."tracking_number" is not null and length(trim("shipments"."tracking_number")) > 0 and "shipments"."shipped_at" is not null)

banner_schedule_valid.name: banner_schedule_valid
banner_schedule_valid.value: "banners"."ends_at" is null or "banners"."starts_at" is null or "banners"."ends_at" > "banners"."starts_at"
